name: Huggingface Provider
description: This enables the use of Huggingface Inference API for the AI module.
project_description:
Looking for extreme flexibility with over 1 million models? Huggingface is your solution. Integrated with the AI module , Huggingface enables access to a vast library of models for specialized tasks such as Text Classification , Image Classification , and more, offering unparalleled customization for your AI needs.

 Features 
 Take advantage of Huggingface’s repository of over 1 million models to create highly custom applications. Whether you need Text Classification , Image Classification , or other advanced machine learning models, Huggingface provides cutting-edge solutions alongside the AI module family.

 Post-Installation 
 
 Set up your API key using the Key module with your Huggingface account. 
 Visit /admin/config/ai/providers/huggingface and connect your API key. 
 Now you can access Huggingface's extensive model library for your projects. 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 The AI module .

 Supporting this Module 
 Support the AI module on OpenCollective .

 Community Documentation 
 The documentation is available on https://project.pages.drupalcode.org/ai/
